parameters.name: input_dir
parameters.description: Directory containing the motion-correction results and the raw asset metadata. Searched recursively for the registered movie.
parameters.help_text: Directory containing the motion-correction results and the raw asset metadata. Searched recursively for the registered movie.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory where output files will be saved.
parameters.help_text: Directory where output files will be saved.

parameters.name: start_frame
parameters.description: First frame of the movie block used for the main analysis.
parameters.help_text: First frame of the movie block used for the main analysis.

parameters.name: end_frame
parameters.description: Last frame of the movie block used for the main analysis.
parameters.help_text: Last frame of the movie block used for the main analysis.

parameters.name: crop
parameters.description: Pixels to remove from each edge before analysis, as the JSON list '[px_y, px_x]'. Useful to drop motion-correction edge artefacts. Defaults to [30, 30].
parameters.help_text: Pixels to remove from each edge before analysis, as the JSON list '[px_y, px_x]'. Useful to drop motion-correction edge artefacts. Defaults to [30, 30].

parameters.name: max_pixel_range
parameters.description: Pixel value at or above which saturation is counted.
parameters.help_text: Pixel value at or above which saturation is counted.

parameters.name: min_pixel_range
parameters.description: Pixel value at or below which under-saturation is counted.
parameters.help_text: Pixel value at or below which under-saturation is counted.

parameters.name: decay_time
parameters.description: Estimated half decay time of the event reporter, in seconds. The default is for GCaMP6f.
parameters.help_text: Estimated half decay time of the event reporter, in seconds. The default is for GCaMP6f.

parameters.name: frame_rate
parameters.description: Frame rate in Hz, used only when it cannot be resolved from the acquisition metadata or the upstream motion-correction provenance. It scales the epilepsy event widths and every per-second photon statistic, so it is never defaulted silently.
parameters.help_text: Frame rate in Hz, used only when it cannot be resolved from the acquisition metadata or the upstream motion-correction provenance. It scales the epilepsy event widths and every per-second photon statistic, so it is never defaulted silently.

parameters.name: dff_single_event_size
parameters.description: Estimated dF/F event size of the event reporter for single events, in arbitrary units. The default is for GCaMP6f.
parameters.help_text: Estimated dF/F event size of the event reporter for single events, in arbitrary units. The default is for GCaMP6f.

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: Round-trip the emitted processing.json and quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing.
parameters.help_text: Round-trip the emitted processing.json and quality_control.json through the core v2 schema objects after writing.
